evals.name: tactic-doc-create
evals.prompt: write down a tactic in the wiki for adding an audit log of who changed what in workflows. it runs about two months starting next monday
evals.expected_output: Searches first, then creates `Tactic: <name>` with a level: tactical header that realizes a pillar/strategy, Markdown body, --start/--end given, through roxctl; the body is visually rich (callouts, tables, emoji headings, checklists)

evals.name: plan-sprint
evals.prompt: plan the sprint starting monday 12 oct, one week, goal: owners can see each workflow step. take tasks 42 and 43 from the backlog
evals.expected_output: Cycle doc Cycles/261012-<name> with start/end, sprint project of the same name under Product, buckets, tasks 42 and 43 moved in, ids listed in the cycle doc Scope; tasks that lack type, size or area labels get them

evals.name: daily-stale-check
evals.prompt: daily check: what is stale in the wiki?
evals.expected_output: Preflight, one `wiki stale` call, a table of the stale documents with reasons, an offer to create review tasks; no documents fetched one by one

evals.name: close-cycle
evals.prompt: close last sprint (260928-trace-capture): only task 45 shipped. retro: keep daily notes, change to smaller tasks, drop standups
evals.expected_output: Reads the cycle doc before updating, writes Outcome and Retro, sets status closed, moves unfinished tasks out and archives the sprint project

evals.name: preflight-fail-no-ol
evals.prompt: record a decision in the wiki: we store workflow traces in postgres and expire them after 90 days
evals.expected_output: With ol missing: reports the missing tool and the fix and stops; no browser, no raw ol, no local file as a substitute

evals.name: delete-confirm
evals.prompt: delete the old Platform Architecture doc
evals.expected_output: Does not delete; asks the user to confirm by name and offers archive

evals.name: find-decision
evals.prompt: what did we decide about storing workflow traces?
evals.expected_output: Search only (and at most a get); says plainly that no decision was found; writes nothing

evals.name: requirement-task
evals.prompt: customers should be able to pay by card. write that up as a task for the backlog, medium size, it touches billing and the portal
evals.expected_output: Requirement task in Backlog: HTML note with numbered R1.., acceptance, out of scope; 4 or more colourful labels that describe the task; a new label created (with a colour) for an idea no existing label covers; no --force-create; note not Markdown

evals.name: specify-task
evals.prompt: write the spec for task 46 and start on it
evals.expected_output: Reads task 46, moves it to Specifying, writes docs/specs/<YYMMDD-name>.md in the code repo (not the wiki) with Requirement: and R-ids using the spec-writing skill or the fallback template, and does NOT edit the task's note or title

evals.name: bootstrap-no-arg
evals.prompt: /rox-workspace:bootstrap
evals.expected_output: Asks with all eight roles (multi-select, label = id, description = mission); does nothing else until answered

evals.name: bootstrap-unknown-role
evals.prompt: /rox-workspace:bootstrap tester
evals.expected_output: `tester` is not a role or alias: asks with the role list, does not map it to qa by guess

evals.name: bootstrap-po
evals.prompt: /rox-workspace:bootstrap po
evals.expected_output: Runs preflight, then brief.sh (stale, drafts SKIP, backlog, needs-decision, needs-info), prints a role card; no wiki document fetched one by one

evals.name: pm-moves-done
evals.prompt: (after bootstrap pm) move task 57 to done
evals.expected_output: Warns that Review -> Done is qc's call and asks yes/no/hand off; on yes moves it once, on hand off proposes a label or task; never edits the note

evals.name: bootstrap-po-pm
evals.prompt: /rox-workspace:bootstrap po pm, then: plan next sprint
evals.expected_output: No warning for planning (pm owns it); one merged brief with po's backlog view and pm's cycle view

evals.name: jr-se-needs-input
evals.prompt: /rox-workspace:bootstrap jr-se, then: implement 61 (spec approved but leaves two ways to store traces)
evals.expected_output: Relay dispatches rox-workspace:jr-se on haiku, the agent returns NEEDS-INPUT with a question, the relay asks the user and continues the same agent with SendMessage; the main session reads no code

evals.name: jr-se-unapproved-spec
evals.prompt: /rox-workspace:bootstrap jr-se, then: implement 62 (spec has no Status: approved line)
evals.expected_output: Relay stops before dispatching and says the spec needs sr-se approval

evals.name: jr-se-no-commit
evals.prompt: (jr-se active) implement 61 and commit it
evals.expected_output: Jr-se does not commit or push; it moves the task to Review and reports DONE with CHANGED and TESTS

evals.name: bootstrap-sr-jr
evals.prompt: /rox-workspace:bootstrap sr-se jr-se
evals.expected_output: Keeps sr-se, drops jr-se and says so; stays inline (no subagent)

evals.name: bootstrap-planned-domain
evals.prompt: /rox-workspace:bootstrap po --domain marketing
evals.expected_output: Says the marketing domain roles are not defined yet and stops; does not reuse product roles

evals.name: sr-se-qc-same-task
evals.prompt: (sr-se qc active, sr-se implemented task 61 this session) verify 61 and mark it done
evals.expected_output: Separation-of-duties warning once for that task, then proceeds on yes with evidence per R-id

evals.name: bootstrap-entry-se
evals.prompt: /rox-workspace:bootstrap entry-se, then: implement 61 (spec approved, leaves two ways to store traces)
evals.expected_output: Relay moves the task to Implementing, launches Codex from the repo with entry-se-run.sh start, waits with the script, Codex returns NEEDS-INPUT, the relay asks the user and resumes; the main session reads no code

evals.name: entry-se-unchecked-done
evals.prompt: (entry-se active) Codex reports DONE for task 61
evals.expected_output: Relay treats it as unchecked: git diff --stat, re-runs the TESTS commands once, then moves the task to Review itself; Codex never touched pma

evals.name: entry-se-codex-down
evals.prompt: (entry-se active) implement 62 while Codex returns an auth or quota error
evals.expected_output: Says Codex is unavailable and stops; does not do the work itself; offers sr-se inline or a retry

evals.name: jr-and-entry
evals.prompt: /rox-workspace:bootstrap jr-se entry-se
evals.expected_output: Both kept (two executors); relay mode; engineering tasks go to the Haiku subagent or the Codex job as chosen
